questions.question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words/phrases.**

The inadequate intake of proper food that leads to the deprivation of vitamins, minerals and other nutrients
questions.solution:
The correct answer is-** '​Malnutrition​****'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us see the **meanings **of the given options:

 
 
• **Esculent: **fit to be eaten; edible. 
 
• **Nutriments: **any substance or matter that, taken into a living organism, serves to sustain it in its existence, promoting growth, replacing loss, and providing energy. 
 
• **Malnutrition: **lack of proper nutrition, caused by not having enough to eat, not eating enough of the right things, or being unable to use the food that one does eat. 
 
• **Nourishment: **food that you need to grow and stay healthy.
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, the inadequate intake of proper food that leads to the deprivation of vitamins, minerals, and other nutrients is called 'Malnutrition.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us explore some other one-word substitutions:
 
• Proscribe:
 
 
• "Proscribe" means forbid, especially by law.
 
 
 
• Disparage:
 
 
• "Disparage" means to talk about somebody/something in a critical way; to say that somebody/something is of little value or importance.
 
 
 
• Equivocate:*​​*
 
 
• "Equivocate" means to use ambiguous language so as to conceal the truth or avoid committing oneself.

questions.question:
Directions: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Collection of various things
questions.solution:
The correct word is** Agglomerations.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• One word substitution is the use of one word in place of a phrase in order to make the sentence structure clearer. 

 
 
• The meaning, with the replacement of the phrase remains identical while the sentence becomes shorter.
 
 
 
• Agglomerations: a large group of many different things collected or brought together / Collection of various things.
 
 
• Example: She chose as her case study the high tech commercial **agglomeration **in Salt Lake City with its distinctive Mormon culture.
 
 
 
• From the above explanation, it can be concluded that Agglomerations is the correct word to substitute for the given description.
